_comment: Blackjack SFX manifest. basePath is prepended to every url. A sound's url may be a single file OR an array of interchangeable takes (one picked at random per play) — to add variety, just add more entries to the array; filenames only need to match what you list here. bus is one of: sfx, music, ambience. Missing files stay silent.
_music_comment: Background music. Plays from initial load in a shuffle bag (every track once before any repeat, no repeat across the seam). Each entry: url (required), title, artist, cover (all optional). cover is a relative path under basePath; if omitted a placeholder disc shows in the Now Playing toast. The toast is suppressed on the lobby/menu, so startup music plays with no UI.
